test_title: PYST 6: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct option:

Barely ______ announcement concluded when inquiries flooded the hotline.
solution:
The correct answer is '**had**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb "**had**" is used to describe an action completed before another action in the past.
 
• The sentence uses the structure of a past perfect tense, where "**had**" is followed by a past participle to indicate the earlier action.
